title: Integral Weyl Invariants in Chow Characteristic Images of Spin and Special Clifford Groups
summary: Let $G=\Spin(n)$ be the split spin group over an arbitrary field, with $n\ge7$. Extending a Steenrod-theoretic obstruction of Karpenko, we classify the recursively defined integral Weyl invariants $q_i$ in the Benson--Wood generating set that lie in the Chow characteristic image: the only such invariant is $q_3$ for $\Spin(10)$. We obtain the analogous classification for the recursive invariants $f_i$ of the special Clifford group $Γ^+(n)$: in their finite generating range, the only such invariant is $f_2$ for $Γ^+(7)$.
